%% Language and encoding
\usepackage[english]{babel}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}

%% pdfTeX has no CJK glyphs: one stray IME 」 was a fatal compile error (XeTeX/tectonic read UTF-8 natively).
\usepackage{iftex}
\ifPDFTeX
  \DeclareUnicodeCharacter{3000}{\ }%               ideographic space
  \DeclareUnicodeCharacter{3001}{,}%                、
  \DeclareUnicodeCharacter{3002}{.}%                。
  \DeclareUnicodeCharacter{300C}{\textquoteleft}%   「
  \DeclareUnicodeCharacter{300D}{\textquoteright}%  」
  \DeclareUnicodeCharacter{300E}{\textquotedblleft}%  『
  \DeclareUnicodeCharacter{300F}{\textquotedblright}% 』
  \DeclareUnicodeCharacter{3010}{[}%                【
  \DeclareUnicodeCharacter{3011}{]}%                】
  \DeclareUnicodeCharacter{FF08}{(}%                （
  \DeclareUnicodeCharacter{FF09}{)}%                ）
  \DeclareUnicodeCharacter{FF0C}{,}%                ，
  \DeclareUnicodeCharacter{FF1A}{:}%                ：
\fi

%% Colors (load early to avoid option clashes with tikz, pgfplots, tcolorbox)
% Include all common color options: table (for colortbl), svgnames (for tcolorbox)
\usepackage[table,svgnames]{xcolor}

%% Line numbers — MUST load before siunitx: lineno patches the output routine
%% with \interlinepenalty\linenopenalty, which siunitx's number parser otherwise
%% chokes on ("Invalid number" at \end{frontmatter}).
\usepackage{lineno}

%% Mathematics
\usepackage{amsmath, amssymb, amsthm}
\usepackage{siunitx}
\sisetup{round-mode=figures,round-precision=3}

%% Graphics and figures
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usepackage{pgfplots, pgfplotstable}
\usetikzlibrary{positioning,shapes,arrows,fit,calc,graphs,graphs.standard}

%% Tables
\usepackage{booktabs, colortbl, longtable, supertabular, tabularx, xltabular}
\usepackage{csvsimple, makecell}

%% Table formatting
\renewcommand\theadfont{\bfseries}
\renewcommand\theadalign{c}
\newcolumntype{C}[1]{>{\centering\arraybackslash}m{#1}}
\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.5}
\definecolor{lightgray}{gray}{0.95}

%% Layout and geometry
\usepackage[pass]{geometry}
\usepackage{pdflscape, indentfirst, calc}
\usepackage{titlesec}  % For custom section formatting

%% Captions and references
%% justification=justified + singlelinecheck=false: captions span the full
%% figure/column width (both edges flush), incl. single-line captions.
\usepackage[margin=10pt,font=small,labelfont=bf,labelsep=endash,justification=justified,singlelinecheck=false]{caption}
\usepackage[numbers]{natbib}  % numbers: numeric citations [1], [2]
\setcitestyle{sort=false}     % Preserve citation order as written
\usepackage{hyperref}
\usepackage{pdfcomment}  % hyperref-compatible static-PDF tooltips (\pdftooltip) for clew provenance marks; survives pdflatex + tectonic, no shell-escape
\usepackage{xurl}  % break long URLs / DOIs at any character so they wrap instead of overflowing the margin
%% expansion=false is REQUIRED: font expansion is FATAL on non-scalable fonts
%% (e.g. elsarticle) -- "pdfTeX error (font expansion): auto expansion is only
%% possible with scalable fonts" -> no output PDF. Protrusion alone is safe and
%% gives most of the overfull-\hbox benefit.
\usepackage[protrusion=true,expansion=false]{microtype}
\setlength{\emergencystretch}{2em}  % last-resort stretch for long unbreakable words (e.g. "Laplace-approximation")

%% Document features (lineno loaded earlier, before siunitx)
\usepackage{accsupp, bashful, lipsum}

%% Visual enhancements
\usepackage[most]{tcolorbox}

%% External references
\usepackage{xr-hyper}

%% Claims — auto-generated by scitex-writer (see 00_shared/claims.json)
%%
%% PLAIN \input, for exactly the reason spelled out in the clew note below --
%% this block is the case that note describes, and it was not applying it.
%% Wrapped as \IfFileExists{f}{\input f}{}, the flattener inlines the file AT
%% the \input site, which is a MACRO-ARGUMENT BODY. TeX assigns catcodes when
%% it TOKENIZES that argument, and @ is still catcode 12 at that moment, so the
%% block's own \makeatletter runs far too late: \v@claim@maybecolor is never a
%% control sequence, it is \v followed by literal text. The whole claims block
%% then TYPESETS as a page of macro noise ahead of the title page.
%%
%% Measured 2026-08-18 on a stock scaffold with every claim feature OFF: page 1
%% of manuscript.pdf read back as
%%   claim@maybecolor[2]ifundenedclew@hex@12ifundenedifclewpresmarkers2hEx@#1
%% It needs no \vclaim use to trigger -- only claims_rendered.tex EXISTING, so
%% \IfFileExists takes the true branch. The stock vendored tree ships one, so
%% every project got the page.
%%
%% Existence is the flattener's job, not LaTeX's: compile_tex_structure only
%% fails loud for latex_styles/ inputs, and emits "% SKIPPED: \input{...} (file
%% not found)" for a non-style one like this before LaTeX ever runs. Same
%% treatment as clew_rendered.tex two lines down, which is the same shape of
%% file (00_shared/, generated, optional) and has always been a plain \input.
\input{../../00_shared/claims_rendered.tex}

%% scitex-writer version stamp — sets PDF creator metadata (invisible in rendered PDF)
%% Plain \input for the same reason as the claims block above. This file holds
%% only \def and \hypersetup, so the catcode misfire does not bite it TODAY --
%% but it is the identical wrapper around the identical class of generated
%% 00_shared/ file, and the day it gains an @-macro it fails the same way.
\input{../../00_shared/scitex_writer_version.tex}

%% Clew presentation layer (RENDERING half — writer owns this).
%% scitex-clew emits 00_shared/clew_rendered.tex (palette + per-claim
%% value/color/badge + aggregate — the WHAT); this style renders it (the HOW).
%% Opt-in toggles (clew_presentation.{markers,badge,signature,legend}) default
%% OFF, so loading the style is a no-op until a manuscript/config enables them.
%%
%% PLAIN \input (NOT wrapped in \IfFileExists): the flattener
%% (compile_tex_structure) inlines \input verbatim AT the \input site. Inside
%% an \IfFileExists{f}{...} arg that site is a MACRO-ARGUMENT BODY, and a style
%% file with \ExplSyntaxOn (:/_ as letters) + \newcommand[1]{#1} cannot survive
%% being grabbed as an argument (catcodes/# misfire -> the block dumps as raw
%% text in the body). At top level it inlines into the preamble verbatim and
%% executes correctly. Existence is handled by the flattener (inlines-or-skips
%% before LaTeX runs); a truly-missing clew_presentation.tex is caught by the
%% flattener's fail-loud (it is a latex_styles file), and a missing
%% clew_rendered.tex is skipped (non-style, optional until clew generates it).
\input{../../00_shared/latex_styles/clew_presentation.tex}
\input{../../00_shared/clew_rendered.tex}
%% Writer opt-in: sets the \clewpres* toggles resolved from
%% .scitex/writer/config.yaml (clew_presentation) by render_clew_toggles.py.
%% AFTER clew_presentation.tex (which defines the \newif's, default OFF) so it
%% overrides them. Non-style + optional -> the flattener skips it when absent
%% (clew presentation OFF), same as clew_rendered.tex.
\input{../../00_shared/clew_presentation_toggles.tex}
